'''Shortcrust pastry''' or '''shortcrust dough''' is a buttery, crumbly [[Cookbook:Pastry Dough|pastry dough]] which is often used as a base for tarts. This is an eggless version.

== Ingredients ==
* 150 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]], softened
* 100 g (½ cup) [[Cookbook:Caster Sugar|caster sugar]]
* 1 tsp grated [[Cookbook:Lemon Rind|lemon rind]]
* 120 g (1 cup) plain [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]], plus extra for dusting
* 120 g (¾ cup) [[Cookbook:Potato|potato flour]]

== Procedure ==
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] together butter, sugar, and lemon rind in a bowl.
# [[Cookbook:Sifting|Sift]] together the plain and potato flours into a mound.
# Make a well in the center of the mound and add the creamed mixture.
# [[Cookbook:Knead|Knead]] lightly until the dough is consistent.
# Wrap the dough in [[Cookbook:Plastic Wrap|plastic wrap]] and chill for 1 hour before use.
